Implemented + independently re-verified headless (Ghidra 12.1.2). C64BankingAnalyzer (AbstractAnalyzer, INSTRUCTION_ANALYZER, priority REFERENCE_ANALYSIS.after(), gated on executableFormat == loader name): forward dataflow to fixpoint (known->conflict->UNKNOWN lattice) from entry/function seeds at banking.initial_state; bank switches recognized via WRITE ref to banking.mechanism.address with backward immediate-load scan (LDA/LDX/LDY #imm, block-bounded, clobber-aware); refs into banked windows retargeted to the state occupant's overlay (reads/exec) or its on_write occupant (writes — incl. write-under-ROM in the HOME state), SourceType.ANALYSIS, set primary, default demoted; EOL 'bank -> N (...)' comments; WARNING bookmark on undeterminable switch; idempotent. MapCompiler now emits banking.mechanism (was dropped); MAP_FORMAT.md updated. Verified: LDA $A000@state5 -> RAM_A000::a000 READ primary; STA $E000@state5 -> RAM_E000::e000 WRITE; STA $A000@state7 -> RAM_A000::a000 WRITE (write-under-ROM); JSR $FFD2 untouched. Subagent-found API gotcha: CodeUnit.getScalar(0) returns null for bare immediates — pull Scalar from getOpObjects instead.

Implemented + independently re-verified (Ghidra 12.1.2 headless, banktest2 + banktest regression). Per-bit PortState(knownMask,bits) replaces the int state: dataflow merge keeps agreeing known bits only (monotone shrink, terminating); store resolution = backward mask-algebra scan with (aAcc,oAcc) accumulators composing AND#imm/ORA#imm, terminating at LDA#imm (fully known), a load of the mechanism address itself (base = tracked in-state — so LDA $01/AND #$FE/STA $01 from known state 5 resolves EXACTLY to 4), or any clobber incl. crossing calls (review fix: JSR fall-through passes the block-linkage check, so calls must clobber explicitly) and crossing mechanism writes (abort, unsound to inherit). Occupant resolution assumes initial_state for unknown bits (user fallback); partial switches get 'bank -> 7? (...) [known: LORAM=1; assumed from initial: HIRAM,CHAREN]' comments; WARNING bookmark only when NO bank bit is known. INFRA FINDING (step 0): SymbolicPropogator/VarnodeContext track whole register values — LDA $01 (unknown memory) poisons the chain; no per-bit partial-knowledge model exists in-tree, so the mask algebra is necessary, not a workaround. All 6 banktest2 criteria + 4 banktest regression criteria pass.

Schema v2 shipped. (a) banking.state = named field tuple ({name,bits}, first field = bit 0); (b) banking.mechanisms[] = strategy instances with opaque params + sets validation; (c) top-level physical[] spaces + window maps: 'SPACE[expr]' with compile-time-validated mini-expression language (ints, state fields, last/second_last/offset, + - *, parens); (d) memory.layouts[] mode-dependent window sets keyed by when:{field:value}.
